decision.exact_command_or_message: To imm26-fix-batch3 (server, 08-b director-mode bored claim): the 4080 i3 operator (agent af494f7d420e43327, NC5 installed, commit c0f7bdd) reports 08-b still FAIL. Cause: stobeSocialFollowupsClaim needs stobeSocialAttentionOptionalSpeechAllowed, which needs in_combat===false (lib/social_attention.php:33-38). Natural DLL bored URIs carry no attn= and Cind has no fresh native_ai snapshot, so in_combat is null and the director bored follow-up claim is denied; NC5's proximity turn (optional=1&attn=) scans squad members only, so non-squad Cind never gets it. Fix on the server side: in director bored turns, when attention is entirely unknown (no attn= and no fresh native_ai snapshot) allow the follow-up claim, but keep the in_combat gate whenever attention data exists (known in_combat=true still denies). Do not change the DLL (an attn= addition to natural bored URIs would be a native NC change; report it to me as an option only). Patch live tree and ss-merge by anchor script (check git log/status in the live tree first), php -l, offline stobe-tests, add a test for the null-attention case, then send a checkpoint. Do not touch any lane.
decision.why: The root cause is the server gate and the fixer already owns the 08-b director-mode claim; the draft's preferred attn= fix is a DLL change outside a server fixer's scope, so the server-side unknown-attention allowance is the actionable fix.
